name: cascade_delete
description: In main.go, function deleteCustomer, the transaction explicitly deletes child rows with `DELETE FROM orders WHERE o_custkey = ?` before deleting the parent customer with `DELETE FROM customer WHERE c_custkey = ?`. This matches an application-level cascade delete, and the separate read endpoint ordersSummary depends on `orders` (`SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(o_totalprice) FROM orders`), so deleting a customer permanently removes order rows that the summary endpoint expects, causing incomplete historical results.
